known_limitations: SEC-01 (Advisory): Default fallback static HMAC secret key (DEFAULT_SECRET_KEY) in manifest.py must be replaced with mandatory RESECURE_HMAC_SECRET env var in production.
SEC-02 (Advisory): PathTraversalGuardMiddleware currently checks relative sequences ('..', '\x00'); absolute system paths (e.g. C:\Windows\System32, /etc/passwd) require a storage jail root check.
SEC-03 (Advisory): Parity container (.rsparity) parser unpacks version and chunk bounds without upper-bound assertions, allowing potential allocation bombs from untrusted files.
SEC-04 (Advisory): Protection service buffers entire file chunks in slice_file_into_chunks, which can exceed the 150MB RSS limit on 2GB files unless refactored to rolling sub-blocks.
SEC-05 (Advisory): Uncaught RecursionError in validate_json when parsing maliciously nested JSON > 2,000 brackets before depth checks execute.
SEC-06 (Advisory): repair_file_format writes directly to output_path instead of staging atomically via temporary files.
SEC-07 (Advisory): CORS wildcard configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True.
SEC-08 (Advisory): 9 transitive NPM vulnerabilities detected in build tools (braces, esbuild) requiring overrides in package.json.
downstream_actions: Backend Agent: Implement SEC-01 through SEC-06 remediations during production hardening sprint.
DevOps Agent: Add SEC-08 dependency overrides in frontend package.json, configure production secrets management for RESECURE_HMAC_SECRET.
Lead Agent / QA Agent: Perform final acceptance verification and gate merge to main branch.
